{{Quote|As you know, when you left our homeland, Uncle Mef succeeded Father as our ruler. But now our cousin Punt has proclaimed himself to be king.|[[Oobel]], to Mring-Mring|<ref name="Land of the Gupins" />}}
'''Mef''' was a [[Gupin/Legends|Gupin]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]].<ref name="Land of the Gupins" /> By [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Date note" /> Mef succeeded the [[Oobel's father|previous ruler]] of the [[Gupin stronghold|stronghold]] and became the Gupin [[King/Legends|king]]. When the [[Limb/Legends|wingless]] Gupin [[Mring-Mring]] left the Gupin homeland, his cousin [[Punt]] proclaimed himself to be king,<ref name="Land of the Gupins" /> and Mef [[Death/Legends|died]].<ref name="Droids\Ewoks" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mef was mentioned in "[[The Land of the Gupins]],"<ref name="Land of the Gupins" /> the eighth episode of the animated television series [[Ewoks (television series)|''Ewoks'']]. The episode was written by [[Bob Carrau]] and premiered on [[October 26]], [[1985]].<ref name="Insider 27">{{InsiderCite|27|A Star Wars CELibration|A ''Star Wars'' CELibration}}</ref>
